name: Haan
body:
HAAN
CR 3

XP 800
CN Large monstrous humanoid
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (–1 size, +3 Dex, +1 natural, +2 armor)
hp 30 (4d10+8)
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (average)
Melee 2 claws +6 (1d6+2 B&S)
Ranged synthetic light crossbow +7 (2d6 P, 19–20/×2, 80-ft. range incr., AP 1 CW)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks balloon, firespray

STATISTICS

Str 15 (+2), Dex 17 (+3), Con 14 (+2), Int 8 (–1), Wis 12 (+1), Cha 10 (+0)
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 20
Feats Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Fly +8, Perception +8, Stealth +6
Languages Common, Haan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Balloon (Ex)

A haan can create and inflate a web balloon and attach it to an adjacent enemy. This requires a combat maneuver attempt made in place of a ? melee attack.

The target must be no larger than the Haan’s size category, and the attempt does not provoke an attack of opportunity. If the attempt is successful, the target immediately rises 30 feet off the ground in a straight line, and it continues to rise at a speed of 30 feet each round on the haan’s turn. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Every round after the balloon is attached, the target can attempt a DC 14 Reflex save or Strength check to cut or break free of the web balloon. If freeing itself from the balloon causes the creature to fall, it takes falling damage as normal.

This ability does not function in a vacuum or zero gravity. The DC is Constitution-based.

Firespray (Ex)

As a standard action, a haan can spray its flammable lifting gases and light them with sparks, creating a 30-foot cone of flame. All creatures within the cone take 3d6 fire damage (Reflex DC 14 half). The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any sky 13
Organization solitary, pair, or flotilla (3–10)
Treasure standard (carbonfiber armor, synthetic light crossbow with 10 bolts, other treasure)

Haans are a large, arthropod-like humanoid species native to the upper atmosphere of various gas giant planets. Standing some nine feet tall on average, they are strong but lightweight—their bodies producing lighterthan-air gasses that circulate through a special pneumatic system under their chitinous exoskeleton.

Haans can quickly weave webbing from their spinnerets, and they have barbs all over their body that are capable of ejecting the gasses they store to create balloons out of this webbing. They can use these balloons to fly, or to send their opponents reeling.

Alternatively, a haan can take a more offensive tact by setting their bodily gasses directly on fire and spraying them in an arc before them.
